title: fix(docs): gen owns sidebar tags for merged enter paths
author: Drjacky

gist.summary: Gen now assigns sidebar tags to merged Enter API routes by public path instead of trusting Enter's tag strings. Agent routes map to Community Agents, my-model routes to Community Models, /quests/catalog to Quests, and other /account/* routes to Account. The merged spec uses Gen's declared tag list; model status and stats routes also map from the legacy 📊 Monitor tag to Models. This prevents undeclared tags from creating extra, descriptionless sidebar groups. Enter's connected-app routes now use the consistent Account tag in its raw schema.
